gaps: Phase-1 still-port: renders the settled label with `data-state` and `aria-busy` intact; no sweep is animated yet.

STATIC-GRADIENT DECISION (visibility trap): ARC .label sets -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent and paints the text via a JS-driven background-image. The still-port sets an inline `style:background-image="linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor)"` on the label element INSIDE the component so the text renders solid and is never invisible. Callers must not pass their own background-image; Phase 2 replaces this static gradient with the driven sweep.
ARC `children: string` is the status text itself, kept as `children: string` (not a Snippet). React `className` dropped in favour of Svelte `class`; no other public-prop deltas.

`duration` is accepted for API parity but has no effect yet. Deferred to Phase 2: sweep/settle motion values with in-view + page-visibility gating, glide-off on `active=false`, label rise on change, and reduced-motion instant path, via @humanspeak/svelte-motion per MOTION-CONVENTIONS.md.
